components.description: Primary action from the current CSS; palette fallbacks make the isolated preview readable.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:var(--font-family, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:13px;background:var(--accent, #44d6c0);color:var(--action-ink, #001f22);border:1px solid var(--accent, #44d6c0);border-radius:6px;padding:7px 10px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--action-hover, #87e4d2);border-color:var(--action-hover, #87e4d2)}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){background:var(--selection, #86fae3)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus, #86fae3);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:default}

narrative.overview:
Cool petrol depth, warm human presence, and precise electrical energy frame a daily agent workspace. The conversation is the working surface; technical content remains readable and controls remain clearly actionable. Material character comes from color relationships and stable planes rather than texture behind text.

This document captures the current CSS implementation based on integration revision `9f64c05`, including the Live Patina edits. The [style bible](docs/gui-style-bible.md) holds the approved broader direction; its proposed syntax palette and other unimplemented details are not current tokens. CSS in `web/src/tokens.css`, `WorkerChat.css`, `MountedForm.css`, and message presentation is the implementation source. Fixture validation passed on 2026-10-12; see docs/live-patina-validation.md for evidence and scope.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous petrol surfaces and warm ivory reading text.
Verdigris filled primary actions with deep ink labels.
Brass attention cues and bright mint focus and selection.
Flat reading surfaces, restrained rounded controls, and readable code.

rules.name: The Current Rule
rules.body: Reserve filled verdigris for primary actions; keep evidence disclosures and navigation quiet.

dos: **Do** use semantic CSS roles rather than copying seed swatches into components.
**Do** retain deep ink text on bright primary actions and selection.
**Do** preserve quiet evidence controls and readable prose and source.
**Do** verify contrast and browser behavior after palette changes before claiming acceptance.
donts: **Don't** treat the style bible's proposed syntax colors as implemented highlighting.
**Don't** place textures, blur, glowing text, or decorative machinery behind conversation content.
**Don't** infer completion or activity from a color or a retained result.
